committee.strongest_dissent: Post-pandemic U.S. airline consolidation, premium-cabin mix, and AAdvantage co-brand mile sales have structurally lifted mid-cycle cash generation; steady $3B+ operating cash flow will pay down the $29B debt stack without dilution, making today's ~$15 equity a mispriced option on deleveraging that will re-rate toward $25+ per share as net debt falls and normalized owner cash compounds.
unresolved_items: Filing-supported maintenance versus growth capex split plus a two-year net-debt reduction schedule funded by owner cash without dilutive refinancing — required to test whether the $4.70/sh OCF proxy is truly reinvestable owner earnings rather than cyclical cash consumed by mandatory fleet capital.

Standalone AAdvantage co-brand cash economics (annual partner mile sales, margin, and renewal terms) from SEC filings or management disclosure, to test whether loyalty is a separable competitive advantage or already fully embedded in consolidated operating cash flow.

Year-by-year debt and finance-lease maturity schedule with annual interest expense, weighted-average coupon, and covenant headroom reconciled to the FY2025 10-K debt footnote, so a credit-tightening stress case can be run on equity recovery versus dilution.
